div.ab: "In the name of God. First: I greet and I salute the health of your . . . . . . Sonship. The peace of God to you! After this: I inform you that my business has become for me something like chaos (?) regarding our cattle. And my camel herder has told me that you have gone back on him. And, if that affair gives you trouble, we shan't burden you with trouble. And your wish stands, being all right with me, and the payment. If you urge (?) it I will complete it if God will. Salvation in the Lord. And, if you wish them, write: I shall not refuse, I shall cancel it for you. Write, tell me."

listBibl.bibl: Worrell WH, PMich Coptic III, 194, 1942, Pl VI
